planPhases.title: Create AuthContext (src/context/AuthContext.tsx) with User type, AuthProvider, and useAuthContext hook — hydrates from localStorage, exposes login/register/logout actions
Update src/api/productsApi.ts to attach JWT from localStorage (key auth_token) as Authorization header, falling back to the hardcoded benchmark token when absent
Create src/pages/LoginPage.tsx — email + password form, POST /api/auth/login, stores token + user in localStorage on success, shows 'Invalid email or password' on 401, loading state on submit button

Create src/pages/SignupPage.tsx — email/username/password/confirmPassword form, client-side password mismatch check, POST /api/auth/register, stores token + user on success, shows server error messages on 409/400, loading state
Update src/components/NavBar.tsx — show Sign Up and Log In links when logged out; show username and Log Out button when logged in; Log Out calls AuthContext.logout() and redirects to /login
planPhases.notes: Also added AuthProvider wrapper to App.tsx (minimum needed to avoid breaking existing tests that render <App /> without a provider)

planPhases.title: Create src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx — renders children when authenticated, redirects to /login otherwise

Create src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx — displays username/email/createdAt, edit form pre-filled with current values, PATCH sends only changed fields, cancel discards changes, 409/400 error display, updates localStorage on success
planPhases.notes: Also added updateUser(user) to AuthContext so profile updates propagate through React state (not just localStorage), allowing NavBar to reflect username changes immediately.

planPhases.title: Update src/App.tsx — wrap with AuthProvider, add /signup and /login routes, add /profile ProtectedRoute
planPhases.notes: Added LoginPage, SignupPage, ProfilePage imports; added /login and /signup as top-level routes; added /profile as a ProtectedRoute inside AppLayout. All 32 tests pass, build succeeds.
